_doc: R3 P1 — REVIEWED PINS: a known divergence between a surface and the contract oracle, recorded so the gate stays green WHILE the divergence is exactly as recorded. key = observable|fact|S|brand|lp; observedShape = the comparator's normalized observation. The surface changing to AGREE makes the pin STALE (RED: remove it); changing to anything else is RED. A pin is never an exclusion: the cell is compared on every run.
